div.p: A small residential suburb east of the Moonee Ponds Creek wetlands, Jacana is bounded by the Western Ring Road in the south and Pascoe Vale Road in the east. Named for a tropical waterbird, the suburb has a high proportion of its workforce employed in the manufacturing sector.
